content:
Here's your silly poem:

In a world where cats drive,
A Kia was found to be quite rare.
It drove with its tail wagging,
And it had a license plate that read "Kitty."

The driver, a cat named Whiskers,
Had a plan to make the most of his time.
He'd race around town,
With his new friend, a dog named Fido.

But as he drove, he realized,
That cats and cars don't mix very well.
So he stopped for a drink,
And decided to go home instead.
